ability.jojorpg.abdominal_machine_gun.de: A machine gun inside Stroheim's stomach region, able to shoot 600 armor-piercing rounds per minute, and capable of piercing a steel plate. Stroheim first introduces this weapon against Kars.
ability.jojorpg.afterimages.desc: Those who have trained in Sendō gain extremely quick movements, footwork, and agility, allowing Dire to create afterimages when he moves.
ability.jojorpg.anti_ripple_wires.desc: Wamuu's head gear is specially designed to be an "Anti-Ripple Tool". The head gear contains wires that Wamuu used to nullify Caesar's Ripple-charged bubbles, by spinning his head and knocking the bubbles away. Also, the head gear has a hole that opens up allowing his horn to drill out, enabling him
ability.jojorpg.anubis_learning_blade.de: Remembers every attack - it never loses twice.
ability.jojorpg.anubis_selective_intangi: Its blade passes through walls to cut what is behind.
Possesses whoever draws it and makes them a master swordsman.
ability.jojorpg.atum_binary_soul_reading: Reads the soul - a yes or no answer can never be hidden.
ability.jojorpg.atum_soul_steal.desc: Draws the soul into a doll.
ability.jojorpg.axe_wielding.desc: Winzaleo wields a giant battle-axe and is notable for being skilled with axes. He is capable of using it with either one or two hands. His attacks consist of swinging the axe, slamming it on the ground, and thrusting it forward. By slamming his axe on the ground, he can create several seismic waves.
ability.jojorpg.bastet_magnetic_attracti: Whoever touches it becomes a magnet; metal flies at them.
ability.jojorpg.bastet_magnetized_debris: Metal objects rocket towards the target.
ability.jojorpg.body_spikes.desc: As a vampire, Wired Beck has complete control of every aspect of his body. His main form of attacking is by sharpening the hair protruding out of his limbs into spikes. Coupled with his unorthodox speed, Wired Beck is capable of lunging at his opponents and delivering them a lethal embrace.
ability.jojorpg.bubble_barrier.desc: Sometimes used in conjunction with Bubble Launcher; the difference is that instead of multiple being used in a barrage, Caesar conjures a single gigantic bubble capable of absorbing and trapping its target.
ability.jojorpg.bubble_cutter.desc: Based on his grandfather's Ripple Cutter, this technique is a direct improvement on the Bubble Launcher, and creates bubbles with the ability to slice. Unlike the original attack, the bubbles spin at high speed and use centrifugal force, but are able to stay intact due to the Ripple. This causes the
ability.jojorpg.bubble_cutter_gliding.de: A more versatile version of Bubble Cutter, Caesar sacrifices the quantity of the attack, and focuses on effectiveness. By launching a few bubbles, he is able to aim them much like homing projectiles. They are able to go around objects and have a higher chance of hitting the opponent.
ability.jojorpg.bubble_launcher.desc: Caesar fires out a barrage of bubbles from their gloves, each coated in the Ripple. This increases the density of the bubbles and allows them to hit objects with a greater impact. When hit by the barrage, a grown man would be completely blown away.
ability.jojorpg.bubble_lenses.desc: Caesar produces Ripple-infused bubbles that have the ability to refract light and focus them into beams, much like a magnifying glass. After launching them, the bubbles become stationary and any light source passing through will cause a domino effect, connecting the bubbles together and eventually s
ability.jojorpg.cat_foot_stance.desc: Caesar instinctively assumes a special defensive stance by relaxing his legs and feet, allowing him to pounce in any direction with greater speed and agility. Known as the "Cat-Foot Stance", the posture is commonly used in Kenpō, though Caesar himself has never received formal training in it.
ability.jojorpg.clacker_boomerang.desc: Joseph throws both pairs of clackers infused with the Ripple into a beam or pillar behind the opponent, fooling the foe into assuming that he missed. One gets stuck onto whatever it was thrown on and starts spinning, latching onto the second pair of clackers. The second pair then flings back towards
ability.jojorpg.clacker_volley.desc: Joseph chucks clackers infused with the Ripple into his opponent's direction. This can be done a number of ways, but to produce the best and most surprising effect, he can hide them behind his back. From there, Joseph can slingshot them from behind his back at the enemy in all directions.
ability.jojorpg.claws.desc: In battle, Wang Chan chooses to wear gloves with long claws to increase his power and attack range. He is confident in his ability to kill a human by a single swipe of his rigid claws, though he still needs to attack from a relatively-close distance. This is omitted in the anime.
A chop that can take a head off.
ability.jojorpg.cream_void_bite.desc: Its mouth leads into the void.
ability.jojorpg.cream_void_sphere.desc: Swallows Vanilla Ice and itself into the void and erases everything in their path.
ability.jojorpg.cyborg_eyes.desc: Stroheim's right eye incorporated several lenses allowing him to zoom on an object and notice minute details. This ability only appears in the anime.
ability.jojorpg.danse_macab_hair.desc: Through unknown means, Bruford developed a technique that allowed him to use his hair in combat as a weapon while he was still alive. His hair acted as a third arm, able to entwine things and serve as a distraction. His standard method of fighting consisted of using his hair first and following with
ability.jojorpg.dark_blue_moon_barnacles: Barnacles that drain the victim's strength.
Calls Dark Blue Moon out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.dark_blue_moon_underwate: Lightning-fast strikes, strongest in the water.
ability.jojorpg.death_thirteen_dream_wor: Drags sleepers into its dream world, where no other Stand exists.
Calls Death Thirteen out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.death_thirteen_scythe_re: Its scythe reaps in the dream.
ability.jojorpg.deep_pass_overdrive.desc: Zeppeli's last and most powerful Ripple technique. Right before his death, he transfers all his life energy into Jonathan. Using this technique, Jonathan obtains all of Zeppeli's power - causing his strength, agility, and Ripple technique to increase dramatically. This rapid loss of life energy natu
ability.jojorpg.divine_sandstorm.desc: Wamuu's signature technique. The Mode is initiated when Wamuu starts to spin his forearms rapidly from the elbow joint, spinning his right arm to the left and his left to the right. The vacuum created between both arms by their rapid centrifugal motion creates a massive wind storm, bearing enough de
ability.jojorpg.eastern_mystery_chinese_: Amato does a flying kick toward his opponent. According to him, it sends his opponents flying to the netherworld, implying that it's a strong attack. However, it can easily be countered if the enemy is not caught off guard.
ability.jojorpg.ebony_devil_anger_empowe: The more Devo hates, the stronger it becomes.
ability.jojorpg.ebony_devil_doll_possess: Possesses a doll and stalks its prey with a razor.
ability.jojorpg.ebony_devil_manifest.des: Calls Ebony Devil out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.electrified_halberd.desc: Eijkman utilizes a halberd which can generate electricity to paralyze his opponents. His thrusts have enough force to shoot out gusts of wind.
ability.jojorpg.emperor_homing_bullets.d: Bullets that change course in mid-air.
ability.jojorpg.emperor_point_blank_summ: Summons the gun and fires point-blank.
ability.jojorpg.empress_parasitic_growth: Grows out of the victim's body, feeding on them.
ability.jojorpg.empress_vein_bite.desc: Bites and drinks from the host.
ability.jojorpg.erratic_blaze_king.desc: After boiling his own blood, Esidisi extends his blood vessels outside of his body, turning them into long, prehensile needles with which he injects his boiling blood into enemies. He can also use his blood vessels as extra limbs, as shown when he uses them to cut Joseph's string.
ability.jojorpg.erratic_blaze_king_giant: Erratic Blaze King: Giant Cartwheel Prison

After creating several holes in his back, Esidisi makes a huge spinning jump while extending his blood vessels out of the newly created holes, similarly to a hedgehog's spines. He then attacks by using his blood vessels to surround his enemies, giving them little room to escape.
ability.jojorpg.final_mode_atmospheric_r: A Mode typically used as a last resort. Wamuu uses the tubes for his wind suit to gather huge amounts of air and compresses it in his lungs. The air is then released through a slit on the horn of his head, causing it to become as sharp as a razor blade. The wind flails about much like a whip and is
ability.jojorpg.flesh_transmutation.desc: Having extensive knowledge on the anatomies of organic beings, Dio can graft the body parts of different beings together. Initially, he uses this ability to create hybrid animal chimeras that he keeps as pets, as well as deformed zombies such as Doobie, Page, Jones, Plant, and Bornnam. Dio later uti
Zeppeli gut punches someone with his little finger raised, allowing him to reach their diaphragm. By doing so, the target will momentarily lose their breath and be in agony, but will be able to produce the Ripple. Wounds sustained by a normal person can be healed faster. One can also gauge how much
ability.jojorpg.geb_drowning_grip.desc: Seizes the victim and drags them down.
ability.jojorpg.geb_vibration_sonar.desc: Reads every footstep through the sand.
ability.jojorpg.geb_water_claw.desc: Water slashes from a distance, faster than a bullet.
ability.jojorpg.hanged_man_light_manifes: Travels between reflections at the speed of light and strikes from the mirror.
ability.jojorpg.hanged_man_manifest.desc: Calls Hanged Man out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.hanged_man_reflection_am: Leaps out of the victim's own eye.
Slashes with the blade hidden in its wrist.
ability.jojorpg.head_twisting.desc: Adams is capable of twisting his head 180 degrees.
ability.jojorpg.healing.desc: The Ripple can heal fractured bones as well as lessen one's sense of pain. When Jonathan grabs a tree branch, it revives withered flowers, causing them to bloom again. During his battle with Tarkus, he was also able to heal his broken neck after receiving the Deep Pass Overdrive from Zeppeli.
ability.jojorpg.hell_heaven_snake_kill.d: Tarkus's signature method of execution in the Chain Neck Deathmatch. Jumping above his opponent, Tarkus manipulates his chain to strike from below, cornering the opponent from both sides. The chain wraps around the opponent; once Tarkus lands, he pulls on the chain with enough force to tear a human
ability.jojorpg.hermit_purple_divination: Spirit photography and thoughtography reveal where enemies are.
ability.jojorpg.hermit_purple_manifest.d: Calls Hermit Purple out - or back.
Channels the Ripple through the vines - deadly to vampires.
Thorny vines lash out and entangle.
ability.jojorpg.hierophant_green_20_mete: Strings stretched in a 20-metre radius fire Emerald Splash at whatever touches them.
ability.jojorpg.hierophant_green_anatomy: Slips inside a body and controls it like a puppet.
ability.jojorpg.hierophant_green_coiled_: Unravels into tentacles that ensnare a distant target.
ability.jojorpg.hierophant_green_emerald: Fires a torrent of energy shaped like emeralds.
ability.jojorpg.hierophant_green_manifes: Calls Hierophant Green out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.high_priestess_diamond_t: Teeth claimed to be as hard as diamond.
Calls High Priestess out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.high_priestess_mimicry_a: Hides as any mineral object and strikes from inside it.
ability.jojorpg.holys_stand_manifest.des: Calls Holy's Stand out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.holys_stand_thorny_vines: Vines without a fighting spirit to control them; they weaken their user.
ability.jojorpg.horus_icicle_rain.desc: Drops giant icicles on the enemy.
ability.jojorpg.hypnosis.desc: Dio is able to hypnotize living people into obeying his commands, visually represented by beams appearing from his eyes. The effect is shown to wear off if the hypnotized person is struck with Ripple energy. Dio uses this ability to convince Jack the Ripper to become his servant, and later to lure J
ability.jojorpg.indigo_blue_overdrive.de: Lisa Lisa charges Ripple into her fist and hits the ground. The Ripple travels across the floor, creating a circle filled with a complicated pattern. It instantly disintegrates Alejandro Torres into ashes.
ability.jojorpg.intangibility.desc: Wired Beck can camouflage with objects and also phase through them. He does so with a door and sticks his hand out to mimic a doorknob in order to catch Joseph and Lisa Lisa off guard with a surprise attack.
ability.jojorpg.jonathans_stand_manifest: Calls Jonathan's Stand out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.jonathans_stand_spirit_p: DIO divines with the vines of Jonathan's body, like Hermit Purple.
ability.jojorpg.judgement_three_wishes.d: Grants a "wish": clay copies of the departed rise to fight.
ability.jojorpg.justice_fog_puppetry.des: Controls anyone with an open wound through the fog.
ability.jojorpg.justice_wound_strings.de: Pierces holes through the victim's body.
ability.jojorpg.khnum_transfiguration.de: Changes Oingo's face into anyone else's.
ability.jojorpg.life_magnetism_overdrive: Human bodies have a faint magnetic field, allowing them to act as a living magnet when the power of the magnetic field is increased by this Overdrive. That magnetic field is then transferred into the leaves, creating a massive magnetic sheet. With the aid of Zeppeli, Jonathan uses this technique to
ability.jojorpg.light_blades.desc: Kars is able to produce bladed appendages from his arms and legs and use these to reflect blinding light toward his enemies. The light comes from the reflections of tiny, shark teeth-like claws running along the edges of the blades, much like a chainsaw. Kars's blades are sharp enough to cut through
ability.jojorpg.light_body.desc: Kars can emanate a bright light from his body. He can make specific body parts glow, such as his hands, to use as signals, and in combat he can disappear in a flash of light.
ability.jojorpg.lovers_brain_spores.desc: Builds pain-spawning clones in the victim's brain.
ability.jojorpg.lovers_pain_link.desc: Burrows into the brain: any pain Steely Dan feels, the host feels.
ability.jojorpg.luck.desc: As a knight, Bruford was fairly proficient in using swords, having defeated several people during the trial of the 77 Rings. After being revived as a zombie, Bruford wields a sword named Luck. When swung, the blade curves significantly to demonstrate its velocity. After being defeated, he gives it t
ability.jojorpg.luck_and_pluck.desc: After his defeat, Bruford gave Jonathan his sword. It played a major role in the final battle against Dio, where Jonathan was able to counter Dio's freezing ability by infusing the sword with Ripple, in order to avoid direct contact with Dio's body.
ability.jojorpg.magicians_red_crossfire_: Splits the ankh into a spread of flames that surround the target.
ability.jojorpg.magicians_red_life_detec: A flame compass reveals every living thing nearby.
ability.jojorpg.magicians_red_manifest.d: Calls Magician's Red out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.magicians_red_pyrokinesi: Engulfs everything around in heat that can melt steel.
ability.jojorpg.magicians_red_red_bind.d: Ropes of fire bind the target.
ability.jojorpg.meat_invade.desc: Also called Malevolent Meat Morsels. Aside from the standard method of absorbing humans or vampires via his body, Santana can release chunks of his flesh in the shape of leeches, which latch onto and absorb his opponent's blood.
ability.jojorpg.medicinal_usage.desc: The Ripple can heal fractured bones as well as lessen one's sense of pain, allowing Ripple users to use techniques without fear of pain. When Zeppeli uses Forced Ripple Breathing on Jonathan, the latter's breathing heals his fractured arm, which normally would have taken another month or two to comp
ability.jojorpg.medieval_pincer.desc: While hiding in a secret labyrinth, Jack comes across and modifies a medieval torture device. With his strength as a zombie, Jack uses this modified device as a pincer, using its spikes to tear foes and even solid pillars apart.
ability.jojorpg.metal_silver_overdrive.d: Essentially the same as a Sendō Ripple Overdrive, but with the ability to transfer through metal.
ability.jojorpg.needle_vein_strike.desc: All four zombies share the same ability, allowing them to extend veins from the tops of their heads in the direction of their prey in order to suck their blood. If used in a careless manner, these appendages can become entangled.
ability.jojorpg.osiris_soul_steal.desc: Tears out the soul of whoever loses a bet and seals it in a poker chip.
ability.jojorpg.osiris_the_wager.desc: Challenges the opponent to a game.
ability.jojorpg.overdrive.desc: The most basic application of the Ripple. Straizo attacks with either his limbs or an object imbued with the Ripple. He uses it directly onto a chandelier to destroy Page, Jones, Plant, and Bornnam.
ability.jojorpg.overdrive_barrage.desc: When Jonathan jabs fast enough consecutively, he can release multiple Overdrives at once.
ability.jojorpg.poisonous_scimitar.desc: Caineghis utilizes a scimitar infused with poison to eliminate his opponents. He is skilled with wielding it, as he can slash multiple people at the same time while he spins. He can also easily toss and catch his blade.
ability.jojorpg.precognition.desc: The user can predict the future of any individual. Its regular usage allows one to see a few seconds into the future. Extremely skilled users like Tonpetty can see very far into the future of an individual by touching their hands, including their destiny and how they die.
ability.jojorpg.presence_erasing.desc: Sasha is capable of erasing her presence by suppressing her breathing, moving as silently as a snow leopard.
ability.jojorpg.projectile_hand.desc: Stroheim is capable of firing off his mechanical hand with enough force to impale and deeply wound an enemy. Though revealed only towards the end of the arc, Stroheim used it to prevent Kars's escape and pinned him to a plane that went crashing into an active volcano.
ability.jojorpg.rebuff_overdrive.desc: Joseph charges Ripple into his elbows and delivers a powerful strike. This was used during Joseph's fight with Wamuu to retaliate his falling attack.
ability.jojorpg.ribs_blades.desc: Also called Exposed Ribs, Santana is able to control his ribs. Each of them are capable of spinning and moving in any direction. Having a maximum length of and a maximum pressure of per centimeter squared, Santana can use them to either crush or impale his opponents.
ability.jojorpg.ripple_beat.desc: An advanced adhesive technique, Joseph imbues both his fists and feet with the Ripple. To prevent himself from falling down a pillar covered with oil, he flips himself upwards and uses his hands to stick to the blast of oil. He then slides across and propels himself upwards, gaining more distance th
ability.jojorpg.ripple_cutter.desc: Zeppeli spits globs of liquid from between his teeth. The Ripple combined with the liquid makes it sharp and dense enough to cut through solid objects, as well as agile and accurate enough to deflect other projectiles.
ability.jojorpg.ripple_detector.desc: Jonathan imbues a contained liquid or object such as wine with the Ripple. The Ripple will pass through his body and the environment, enabling Jonathan to sense his surroundings and detect others even through walls.
ability.jojorpg.ripple_hair_attack.desc: Joseph infuses his Ripple into strands of hair to make them hard enough to form a barrier, which blocks incoming projectiles. Joseph uses it to block bullets fired by Santana after ripping a fistful of Stroheim's hair.
ability.jojorpg.ripple_hypnosis.desc: Caesar can hypnotize people and animals by using the Ripple on them. The process can involve a kiss or simply touching one's head with their hands. The hypnotized person will act according to his demands and be stronger than an ordinary being, being imbued with the Ripple. Caesar uses it on a woman
ability.jojorpg.ripple_overdrive_beat.de: Joseph traps the opponent with ropes made of 100% wool, then imbues the ropes with the Ripple. It has enough force to slice through Esidisi's face.
ability.jojorpg.ripple_teleferico_ropewa: Lisa Lisa and Sasha both send positive and negative Ripple energy into Sasha's braided cord while holding onto both ends. By doing so, they avoid damaging Octavio and only incapacitate Dos Santos instead, who Octavio was holding onto.
A Ripple Master can use cloth woven from the dried intestinal fibers of the Satiporoja Beetle. The cloth is capable of conducting the Ripple at 100%. Straizo and Lisa Lisa use scarves that are made of 30,000 beetles. As it conducts and disperses the Ripple far better than the human body, it acts sim
ability.jojorpg.satiporoja_beetle_missan: Like Lisa Lisa and Straizo, Sasha utilizes a weapon woven from the dried intestinal fibers of the Satiporoja Beetle. Instead of a scarf like her master, Sasha has a wide braided cord that is around 10 to 20 meters long and capable of conducting the Ripple at 100%. As it conducts and disperses the Ri
ability.jojorpg.saw_hat.desc: Speedwagon wore a bowler hat with a hidden buzz-saw built into it that was sharp enough to cut through bone. Speedwagon used it during his days as a thief, throwing the hat at his opponent as a projectile for a deadly attack. He was extremely proficient with it, being able to juggle with the hat eas
ability.jojorpg.scalpels.desc: Jack uses his immunity to pain to his advantage by inserting sub-dermal scalpels into his body. Once the scalpels are buried in his body, Jack is able to expel them via muscle contraction, shooting the knives over great distances with pinpoint accuracy.
ability.jojorpg.scarlet_overdrive.desc: Charging the Ripple into one hand, Jonathan can create a Ripple of flame. He is able to transfer this flame over to another part of his body, and anything that touches that body part has a chance of catching fire.
ability.jojorpg.seated_jump.desc: Those who have trained in Sendō gain strong legs and knees. Like his grandfather, Caesar is capable of jumping extremely high from a sitting position and then landing on his feet.
ability.jojorpg.sendo_ripple_overdrive.d: Jonathan charges a Ripple wave through his arm and releases it into a solid object, such as a wall or partition. The Ripple can travel through and reach anything on the other side, and anything hit by the Ripple is sent flying in a spiral. If the enemy is an Undead, the Ripple will enter their blood
ability.jojorpg.sendo_wave_kick.desc: A Ripple-infused strike with the knee. The Ripple energy tears vampires and zombies apart upon entering the bloodstream.
ability.jojorpg.sethan_age_reversal.desc: Its shadow turns whoever it touches back into a child.
ability.jojorpg.sethan_shadow_reflection: The shadow stretches across the ground.
ability.jojorpg.silver_chariot_armor_off: Sheds its armour to reach full speed, leaving afterimages.
ability.jojorpg.silver_chariot_flame_ske: Skewers coins and flames in a single thrust.
Calls Silver Chariot out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.silver_chariot_plus_anub: Dual-wielding Anubis, it overwhelms even Star Platinum.
ability.jojorpg.silver_chariot_rapier_ba: Barrages of thrusts before the enemy can react.
ability.jojorpg.silver_chariot_shooting_: Launches the rapier's blade like a bullet.
ability.jojorpg.sledgehammer.desc: Not being able to master the Ripple didn't stop Speedwagon from helping in the fight. He used a sledgehammer powerful enough to kill zombies in just one strike by smashing their heads. This scene is omitted in the anime, but he still uses the sledgehammer later. In the anime, Speedwagon tries to sma
ability.jojorpg.snake_muffler.desc: Lisa Lisa's primary method of fighting involves a scarf made with the yarn of the Satiporoja Beetle, which can conduct the Ripple at 100%. She can channel her Ripple through her scarf to stand upside down, leaving the now rigid scarf the only part of her in contact with the ground. She may also use
ability.jojorpg.space_ripper_stingy_eyes: Dio is able to pressurize bodily liquid in his eyeballs and then create small openings in his pupils, unleashing two fluid jets with enough power to slice through stone. This ability is later referred to by Straizo as "Space Ripper Stingy Eyes." Dio can also aim this attack to some degree, as he tar
ability.jojorpg.star_platinum_bullet_cat: Catches bullets and knives between two fingers.
ability.jojorpg.star_platinum_manifest.d: Calls Star Platinum out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.star_platinum_ora_ora.de: An extremely fast, precise barrage of punches.
ability.jojorpg.star_platinum_star_finge: Extends two fingers to stab from just outside its reach.
ability.jojorpg.star_platinum_superhuman: Inhales with superhuman lung capacity, dragging enemies (and fog Stands) in.
Stops time for about two seconds - and moves inside stopped time.
ability.jojorpg.sticking_ripple_and_repe: Caesar is able to use the Ripple as a repellent and to adhere either himself or objects to other objects and liquids. Joseph and Caesar manage to climb a pillar covered in oil with adhesion, and Caesar uses it to deflect a high pressured oil jet. Later, Caesar and Joseph force Esidisi out of Suzi Q'
ability.jojorpg.stone_form.desc: The Pillar Men possess the ability to turn their body to stone and merge with their surroundings. While mainly being used for hibernation, they can also enter this state while awake to defend themselves. In this form they are immune to the Ripple, sunlight and UV lights, and they absorb blood and li
ability.jojorpg.strength_iron_crush.desc: Crushes the prey with the ship's hull.
ability.jojorpg.strength_ship_manipulati: The ship itself - pipes, chains and rigging close in on the crew.
ability.jojorpg.sun_light_ray.desc: Fires rays of light from the sky.
ability.jojorpg.sun_solar_flare.desc: A flare that sets the sand ablaze.
ability.jojorpg.sun_solar_heat.desc: Scorches the desert like a second sun.
ability.jojorpg.sunlight_yellow_overdriv: Jonathan and Zeppeli have the ability to release devastating Ripple-infused strikes with power comparable to the sun itself. The energy produced by this technique can flow straight through victims to obliterate multiple Undead at once; when delivered through a barrage of punches, it can even revive
Lisa Lisa holds the Red Stone of Aja in one hand and presses it against the opponent before charging it with the Ripple. Her Ripple resembles the color of sunset and creates a red firework, burning the enemy.
ability.jojorpg.switching_winback.desc: A psychological recovery method used by top athletes. When they are under pressure during a match, they can put away their shock, mistakes, and fear deep within their minds. Like flipping a switch, they are able to bring out their fighting spirit. However, they need a ritual in order to flip that sw
ability.jojorpg.tenore_sax_illusion_maze: Turns DIO's mansion into an endless maze of illusions.
ability.jojorpg.tenore_sax_manifest.desc: Calls Tenore Sax out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.tenore_sax_phantom_walls: Corridors and walls that are not really there.
ability.jojorpg.the_fool_manifest.desc: Calls The Fool out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.the_fool_sand_blast.desc: A blast of sand that blinds.
ability.jojorpg.the_fool_sand_decoy.desc: Moulds a sand double while Iggy slips away.
ability.jojorpg.the_fool_sand_glider.des: Spreads into wings of sand to glide.
ability.jojorpg.the_world_knife_throw.de: A fan of silver knives - they hang in stopped time.
ability.jojorpg.the_world_manifest.desc: Calls The World out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.the_world_muda_muda.desc: A flurry of punches stronger and faster than Star Platinum's.
Drives a hand straight through the opponent.
ability.jojorpg.the_world_road_roller.de: ROAD ROLLER DA! Drops a steamroller on the enemy.
ability.jojorpg.the_world_time_stop.desc: Stops time for five seconds; only DIO moves.
ability.jojorpg.thousand_color_overdrive: Lisa Lisa creates a massive electrified dome by imbuing the Ripple on leaves, flowers, and dyed sawdust from destroyed rugs. The materials pile on top of each other in layers to cover an entire plaza from El Señor de las Moscas's swarm of flies.
ability.jojorpg.thunder_cross_split_atta: An advanced version of the Thunder Split Attack that covers its weakness by making his arms form a cross. It is described as a perfect technique in both attack and defense, so no one, aside from Dio, has ever defeated it.
ability.jojorpg.thunder_split_attack.des: Dire jumps at his opponent and does a split with his legs, preventing the opponent from moving their arms. He then attacks his foe's neck with a chop imbued with the Ripple. It's quick enough that Dire is even able to put objects on his opponent without them noticing, as he slips a letter in between
ability.jojorpg.tohth_fateful_link.desc: The prophecy seals the target's fate.
The comic book's prophecies always come true.
ability.jojorpg.tongue_manipulation.desc: Adams can grow his tongue to abnormal lengths, stretching it long enough to grab his prey.
ability.jojorpg.tornado_overdrive.desc: Zeppeli leaps into the air and points his legs toward his opponent. From here, he is able to move the Ripple to his lower half and essentially dive-bombs the opponent in a spinning motion, much like a drill.
ability.jojorpg.tower_of_gray_manifest.d: Calls Tower of Gray out - or back.
ability.jojorpg.tower_of_gray_tower_need: Pierces with its needle tongue at blinding speed.
ability.jojorpg.turquoise_blue_overdrive: Appropriately the strongest place to use the Ripple, Jonathan can release high-powered tempests while underwater with enough force to blast enemies away. Steely Dan then enjoys the pleasure of a strong bridge he made of Jotaro, much to the latter's displeasure.

Because of the link between him and Steely Dan, Joseph can't concentrate on his Stand and attracts people with his gesticulations, forcing them to buy the TV in order to move to a more isolated location. Finally, Polnareff and Kakyoin find Lovers in Joseph's brain.

Afterward, Jotaro gives him "his receipt", and walks away.
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_166.des: Having crossed the Gulf Straight from Karachi, the Joestar group safely arrive in the city of Abu Dhabi, though Kakyoin cannot shake the feeling that they are being followed, thanks in part to their encounters along the way and the "loss" of Avdol. Jotaro, naturally, voices his discomfort at flying in anything with Joseph (who has been in three aircraft crashes in his life), forcing Joseph to change their plans to crossing the desert on camelback, to Polnareff's…
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_166.out: As the heat slowly rises, Polnareff's comment about it rising to 50 degrees leads Joseph to check his watch, only to be stunned at the time (8:10), well past the time the sun should have started to set.

As if sensing their awareness, the temperature jumps to 60 Degrees Celsius, which, coupled by Polnareff noticing the "Sun" is rising from the west, to lead the group to deduce that the "Sun" is, in fact, an enemy Stand.
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_167.des: The Joestar group is confused by this incredible Sun Stand. Joseph says that even in a sauna, staying more than half an hour is dangerous. As the Stand seems to be very powerful, raising the temperature above 70 °C, the user should be close by, but they can't see him.

He tells himself that he should be in Saudi Arabia crossing the desert, and looks over to see a dog sitting next to him. He then finds a balloon, which is carrying a card with a picture of a sinister looking clown with a scythe.

He reveals that he summonmed Hierophant Green before being knocked out, and that he will punish Death Thirteen.

Jotaro says that they're heading in the wrong direction, and that the boat is going towards a small island. Joseph says that they need to meet someone there who is very important to their journey, but does not reveal who it is.

Avdol's fourth wish is to not grant any of Cameo's wishes and he burns him to a crisp.
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_179.des: Polnareff enthusiastically rushes towards the group, excited to share the good news. He reveals to them that Avdol is alive! However the group acts completely nonchalant about it, as if Avdol had simply come back from a paid vacation.

quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_180.des: Within the submarine, the group cautiously stand away from the enemy Stand hiding among the submarine's gauges. Joseph remains unconscious from the Stand's attack. Avdol reveals that the Stand is High Priestess used by Midler, and is a long range Stand that can turn into anything as long as it's made of a mineral.

Avdol explains that they have to escape from the submarine, and the group begins equipping scuba gear.

He explains that they must not panic, and that they must slowly rise to the surface, explaining that if they rise too quickly their lungs and blood vessels will burst. Joseph then tells them they'll have to use hand signals because they can't talk underwater which prompts Avdol to remind him they can talk with their Stands.

quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_182.des: On the sea floor, the group gets sucked into High Priestess's giant mouth. As they get trapped in the Stand's mouth Midler mocks them, stating that she is close by on the seashore. The group stands within the Stand's mouth, and Midler says that Jotaro is her type making it hard for her to kill him.

Joseph states that the Stand user has personality issues, and that that is why it took so long for him to join the others.

N'Doul realizes this and focuses his attack back onto the group.

Firm in his resolutions Polnareff boldly begins to step forward, only to look down at DIO's prompting and find that he hasn't moved at all.
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_248.out: Pushing these feelings aside he bounds forward, claiming he will not die until he at least sees his Stand's abilities and summons Silver Chariot to attack him.

DIO relents and affirms Polnareff's impending death, revealing the physical appearance of his Stand The World for the first time with the intention of killing his opponent, but the arrival of the other crusaders halts…
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_249.des: DIO retreats into the darkness of his mansion moving up the levels as the crusaders burst through the wall, letting sunlight fill the lower part of the room. Before following him Polnareff explains that while he has experienced what he assumes to be the power of DIO's Stand, he does not understand its exact nature. Before following him Polnareff explains that while he has experienced what he assumes to be the power of DIO's Stand, he does not understand its exact nature.

The conversation concludes with Joseph, Jotaro and Kakyoin learning of Iggy and Avdol's demise and the group share a moment of mourning before remarking that they are quickly losing their advantage as the sun sets.
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_249.out: There they find a coffin presumably housing DIO and force Nukesaku to open it.
They are shocked to find the impossible; as Nukesaku pulls the casket lid off within lies a segmented Nukesaku, who even remarks how surprised he is to find the one in the coffin was in fact him.
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_250.des: Confused and frightened, the group leaps from the open window of the tower when Jotaro feels the bloodlust of DIO begin to creep up on him, utilizing their Stands to land safely on the lower roofs of the mansion. Joseph buys a truck with which the two flee, while DIO contemplates the advances in vehicular technology since his time as he forcefully enters the car of a wealthy politician and coerces him to drive.
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_251.des: Despite the threats and arrogance of the politician, DIO simply rips out his teeth and asks him again to get into the driver's seat. Fearful and confused, he decides to leap from the car, only to find himself back inside. He does so multiple times before eventually giving up and appeasing DIO by enthusiastically taking to his demands.

quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_252.des: Hierophant Green launches an Emerald Splash at DIO. With one finger, DIO is able to deflect the attack with ease. Hierophant Green attacks with a more narrow Emerald Splash, but DIO deflects it again with just his hand.

quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_252.out: Joseph and Kakyoin manage to escape, swinging from the rooftops.
As they escape, Kakyoin states that he may have found a way to uncover the secret of The World.
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_253.des: Every time Kakyoin sees Hierophant Green, he remembers his lonely childhood. He believed he could have no friends because no one could see Hierophant Green. He then remembers meeting Joseph, Jotaro, Avdol, Polnareff, and Iggy; how they were the first friends he ever had.

quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_253.out: He approaches Kakyoin and punches him clean through the abdomen.
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_254.des: As DIO finishes off Kakyoin, the time limit on his Stand ends, launching the unaware Kakyoin into a water tower. Then DIO turns his attention to Joseph who he claims is the weakest of the group. With his last breaths, Kakyoin discovers the secret to DIO's Stand and relays the message to Joseph by shooting the clock tower before passing on.

quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_255.des: Thanks to Kakyoin's dying message, Joseph figures out that The World can stop time. Joseph swings from the rooftops, running from DIO to come up with a way to counter The World. DIO stops time and reappears in front of Joseph.

quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_255.out: The knife strikes Joseph right below the throat.
DIO taunts Jotaro, the only one left standing in his way.
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_256.des: Jotaro watches as a knife appears in his grandfather's chest. Joseph warns Jotaro to run away, that he is no match for DIO and his World. DIO tells Jotaro about Kakyoin's death.

DIO leaps back, pondering the similarities between Star Platinum and The World.
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_257.des: Jotaro twitches his finger within the frozen time. DIO ponders whether Jotaro can see in the frozen time or if he's just twitching his finger instinctively. Time resumes.

Jotaro lays still in order to draw in DIO, who appears to believe in Jotaro's death…

In order to avoid Jotaro's immediate range, he grabs a sign and approaches, intending to sever Jotaro's head as proof of his demise.
quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_259.out: This is interrupted by the sudden intervention of Polnareff, who rushes in and manages to pierce DIO through the head with his Silver Chariot.
Although the surprise attack succeeds, DIO's vampire physiology renders the stab useless and he proceeds to strike down Polnareff through the use of The World.

To Jotaro's dismay DIO redirects his attention to the now injured and unconscious Polnareff, which puts Jotaro in a tough position; he can either move and reveal himself to save Polnareff but lose his opportunity to trap DIO, or he can maintain the deception…

quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_260.out: DIO places his ear to the ground to sense Jotaro's heartbeat but Jotaro manages to use Star Platinum to clutch his own heart, causing it to stop and immediately placing Jotaro on the verge of blacking out.

He instead decides Jotaro is of greater concern and returns to his original plan of cutting off his head, only to have Star Platinum deliver a powerful strike to the head when he enters Jotaro's range.

Although he still appears confident, this confidence begins to deteriorate when he discovers the trauma has left him incapable of walking or moving properly because of the brain damage, which also slows his healing factor. Meanwhile, Jotaro retrieves a nearby bucket and punches a hole in the fuel tank of a car to fill it up with gasoline.

The effects of which are mirrored on its user DIO, finally killing him and ending his 100+ year grudge against the Joestar family.

Having lost great friends along the way, they part wordlessly in deep friendship.
